# Desk Reset: Posture Practice

> Desk Reset is an AirPods posture app for iPhone. Take a three-minute guided posture break with live cues from compatible AirPods, plus Apple Watch nudges.

## App

- [AirPods Posture App | Desk Reset: Posture Practice](https://jackwallner.com/ios/posture/index.html.md): Desk Reset is an AirPods posture app for iPhone. Take a three-minute guided posture break with live cues from compatible AirPods, plus Apple Watch nudges.

## Guides

- [Best Posture App for iPhone: 5 Compared (2026)](https://jackwallner.com/ios/posture/best-posture-app.html.md): Five iPhone posture apps compared: AirPods-based reminders, a wearable sensor and photo analysis. Price model, Watch, account and ratings as of October 2026.
- [Desk Posture Checklist: How to Sit at Your Desk](https://jackwallner.com/ios/posture/desk-posture-checklist.html.md): A ten-point desk posture checklist from OSHA workstation guidance: head, elbows, wrists, feet, monitor distance and height, and how often to change position.
